$description: P31 breakpoint dimension tokens — canonical source (consumed by Lane A tier-emitter as a supplement; never hardcode breakpoints in component CSS). px source with rem conversion at 16px root.

compact.$description: Compact window size class upper bound (Material 3: <600dp). Mobile tier. 600px = 37.5rem at 16px root.

medium.$description: Medium window size class upper bound (Material 3: 600-840dp). Tablet tier. 840px = 52.5rem at 16px root.

expanded.$description: Expanded window size class (Material 3: >=840dp). Desktop tier. 1200px = 75rem at 16px root.
